messages:
ellie: Hey team, manager wants to promo an IC who is currently on parental leave and moving to a permanent part-time schedule when they return. They asked if promo can be effective retro to the start of leave so bonus/proration aligns. Thoughts?
marc: Congrats to the IC! Two flags: 1) retro-dating into leave is unusual because payroll/leave benefits were processed under the prior band; 2) part-time FTE changes comp calculations. What effective date are they proposing?
ellie: Manager proposed effective = leave start (6/1) to include Q2 bonus eligibility. Return to work is planned 8/15 at 80% FTE.
hana: Short answer: we prefer effective dates be tied to active pay periods. Retro into a leave period is possible but requires Comp approval + payroll reconciliation and might affect leave pay calculations. Also check benefit eligibility windows and bonus plan rules.
comp-ops: Correct. For retro promos that overlap paid leave we need: (a) payback calc from payroll, (b) confirmation from benefits whether change affects leave pay or accruals, (c) sign-off from Comp Ops on bonus eligibility. If the bonus plan explicitly requires active employment on payout date, retro alone may not make them eligible.
ellie: Manager also submitted minimal evidence (one paragraph). If we need more, what's preferred handback wording?
people-ops-bot: Reference leveling checklist: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/leveling-checklist. Required: impact summary, 2+ concrete examples with measurable outcomes, manager endorsement, peer/internal feedback when available. Use /templates/leveling-evidence.md.
marc: Suggested handback paste: "Thanks — please add 2 specific examples showing scope growth while the IC was active, include measurable outcomes (metrics/OKRs), clarify expected working pattern after return (FTE %), and confirm proposed effective date with payroll and comp. Resubmit within 14 days."
hana: A couple of policy notes: - If effective date is during an unpaid leave the change likely won't alter prior leave pay but may affect future accruals. - Part-time promos: comp bands map differently; comp ops will pro-rate base for 0.8 FTE.
ellie: Manager says exec VP verbally approved retro to protect bonus. Who signs exceptions?
comp-ops: Exception approval flow: Manager + Sr People Ops partner + Comp Ops. Exec verbal is context but we need written approval in the Promo Portal or an email attached. For bonuses, Comp Ops must confirm eligibility rules; if exec wants an override, that needs written exec approval + Comp Ops written concurrence.
marc: Timing rules: if resubmission doesn't happen within 14 days the submission auto-closes and the manager is notified. Exceptions to auto-close require Sr People Ops OK.
ellie: If we allow retro, who handles the payroll recon and communications to payroll?
hana: Payroll handles recon but we (People Ops) must open a reconciliation ticket with payroll + attach the approved calc from Comp Ops. Also inform the manager that net retro may be taxed differently.
comp-ops: If moving to 80% FTE and adjusting base, we'll provide a pro-rate formula and retro calc. Expect manual adjustments in the next payroll cycle.
ellie: OK I'll ask manager to use the handback copy and confirm dates with payroll. Can someone paste a short paste-in template for managers to use in the portal?
marc: Pasteable handback (short): "Please expand evidence: 1) 2 concrete examples with metrics; 2) clarify FTE % after return; 3) confirm proposed effective date with payroll & comp; 4) attach any exec email if claiming exec approval. Resubmit within 14 days."
ellie: Thanks all — I'll close loop once manager resubmits. :raised_hands:
